sub_graphs.title: Altair: Sync Committee Message Timing
sub_graphs.description: Models the timing constraints for sync committee message propagation in the fork choice

nodes.label: Slot Start
nodes.description: A new slot has begun; sync committee members must prepare to broadcast

nodes.label: Compute Sync Message Due Time
nodes.description: Calculate get_sync_message_due_ms(epoch) using SYNC_MESSAGE_DUE_BPS to determine when sync messages should be sent

nodes.label: Sync Message Due
nodes.description: The computed time within the slot when sync committee messages should be transmitted

nodes.label: Broadcast Sync Committee Message
nodes.description: Sync committee member broadcasts their signed sync message to the network

nodes.label: Sync Message Broadcast Complete
nodes.description: Sync committee message has been sent to the gossip network

external_entities.name: Sync Committee Network Peers

sub_graphs.title: Altair: Sync Contribution Timing
sub_graphs.description: Models the timing constraints for sync committee contribution aggregation

nodes.label: Sync Messages Collected
nodes.description: Individual sync committee messages have been received; aggregation can begin

nodes.label: Compute Contribution Due Time
nodes.description: Calculate get_contribution_due_ms(epoch) using CONTRIBUTION_DUE_BPS to determine when contributions should be submitted

nodes.label: Contribution Submission Due
nodes.description: The computed time within the slot when aggregated contributions should be submitted

nodes.label: Submit Sync Committee Contribution
nodes.description: Aggregator submits the aggregated sync committee contribution to the network

nodes.label: Contribution Submitted
nodes.description: Aggregated contribution has been broadcast to the network for inclusion in blocks

edges.label: Due time reached; submit aggregated contribution

external_entities.name: Network Peers
external_entities.description: Peers receiving aggregated sync committee contributions

ambiguities.text: SYNC_MESSAGE_DUE_BPS and CONTRIBUTION_DUE_BPS values are not specified in this document
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume these are defined in a configuration or constants file referenced by the spec. Values determine fraction of slot duration for timing.

ambiguities.text: Full fork choice algorithm modifications beyond timing helpers are not detailed; spec states 'all prior functionality from Phase0 is inherited'
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume Altair fork choice inherits all Phase0 fork choice logic (LMD-GHOST, justified/finalized checkpoints) and only adds sync committee timing.

implicit_assumptions.description: Nodes have reasonably synchronized clocks to coordinate slot-relative timing for sync messages and contributions
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Desynchronized clocks could cause sync committee messages to arrive outside expected windows, reducing participation rates or causing message rejection

implicit_assumptions.description: Phase0 fork choice implementation is fully correct and available as a base for Altair modifications
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Bugs in inherited Phase0 fork choice would propagate to Altair, potentially affecting consensus safety
